title: Move "Dimensionality" tutorial to sphinx-gallery examples
body:
This moves the "Dimensionality tutorial" to examples/dimensionality sphinx gallery (See issues: #1792, #1756 )

Changes:
1. Commented out `view(atoms)` calls to avoid GUI pop-ups when the web page builds

2. Temporarily used `:noindex:` for
 ```
.. autofunction:: ase.geometry.dimensionality.analyze_dimensionality
   :noindex:
 .. autofunction:: ase.geometry.dimensionality.isolate_components
   :noindex:
```

because the functions are currently documented in two places (tutorial + examples), which creates duplicate API entries.


Follow-up:
Remove the duplicate API reference (either from the old tutorial location or the new example or from both) and then drop `:noindex:`.
